title: The Empty Shoes
text: A street lined with shoes, a pair set neatly by every door, as if their owners stepped out of them and kept walking. Bare footprints lead away down the cobbles, hundreds of them, all going the same way. Not one comes back.

options.label: Follow the bare footprints, and learn where they all went.

outcomes.text: To a square where the faceless dance, barefoot and silent, and they let you watch. They do not let you forget.
To where they went, and what took them there.

options.label: The shrewdest searches the empty houses, while their owners are away.

outcomes.text: Every house left as if for a moment, the kettle still warm, and coins on the table.

options.label: Keep your own shoes on, and keep moving, whatever your feet want.

outcomes.text: Your feet ache to be bare all day, and some of you catch yourselves unlacing your boots.
